name: UpdateComputeQuotaPlan

parameters.help_en: The nickname of the level-1 quota
parameters.name: nickname

parameters.help_en: The name of the quota plan
parameters.name: name

fields.help_en: The auto-scaling CU upper limit for general-purpose CPU computing of the level-1 quota
fields.help_zh: 普通 CPU 计算一级 Quota 自动弹性上限 CU
fields.name: auto_scale_cpu_limit

fields.help_en:
The number of elastic reserved CUs for the level-1 quota.

The ElasticReservedCU value of the level-1 quota must be a multiple of 50.
The ElasticReservedCU value of the level-1 quota must be greater than or equal to 0.
The ElasticReservedCU value of the level-1 quota must be less than or equal to the MaxCU value of the level-1 quota
fields.help_zh:
一级Quota弹性预留CU值。

一级Quota ElasticReservedCU必须是50倍数
一级Quota ElasticReservedCU 大于等于0
一级Quota ElasticReservedCU 小于等于一级Quota MaxCU
fields.name: elastic_reserved_cu

fields.help_en: The properties of the level-1 quota
fields.name: parameter

fields.help_en: The nickname of the level-2 quota
fields.name: nick_name

fields.help_en: The auto-scaling CU upper limit for general-purpose CPU computing of the level-2 quota
fields.help_zh: 普通 CPU 计算二级 Quota 自动弹性上限 CU
fields.name: auto_scale_cpu_limit

fields.help_en:
The number of elastic reserved CUs.

The ElasticReservedCU value of the level-2 quota must be greater than or equal to 0. 
The sum of the ElasticReservedCU values of all level-2 quotas must be equal to the ElasticReservedCU value of the level-1 quota
fields.help_zh:
弹性预留CU值。

二级Quota的ElasticReservedCU大于等于0 
二级Quota的ElasticReservedCU总和必须等于一级Quota ElasticReservedCU
fields.name: elastic_reserved_cu

fields.help_en:
The upper limit of reserved CUs.

The MaxCU value of a level-2 quota cannot exceed the MaxCU value of the level-1 quota
fields.help_zh:
预留CU上限。

二级Quota的maxCU不能超过一级Quota的maxCU
fields.name: max_cu

fields.help_en:
The guaranteed number of reserved CUs.

The sum of the MinCU values of all level-2 quotas must be equal to the MinCU value of the level-1 quota.
The MinCU value of a level-2 quota cannot exceed its own MaxCU value
fields.help_zh:
预留CU保障。

所有二级Quota minCU总和需要等于 一级Quota的minCU
二级Quota的minCU不能超过自身的maxCU
fields.name: min_cu

fields.help_en: The properties of the level-2 quota
fields.name: parameter

httpCode.description_en:
The HTTP status code.
1xx: Informational. The request was received and is being processed.
2xx: Success. The action requested by the client was received, understood, and accepted by the server.
3xx: Redirection. The request was redirected, and further action is required to complete it.
4xx: Client error. The request contains bad syntax, invalid parameters, or cannot be fulfilled.
5xx: Server error. The server failed to fulfill the request due to an internal error
httpCode.description_zh:
HTTP状态码。
1xx：信息响应 - 请求已接收，正在处理中。
2xx：成功 - 请求动作已被服务端成功接收、理解并接受。
3xx：重定向 - 请求被重定向，采取进一步行动以完成请求。
4xx：客户端错误 - 请求包含错误请求参、语法或特定请求条件无法满足。
5xx：服务端错误 - 服务器由于其他原因无法满足请求
